description: This file defines API routes related to category management in a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting categories, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define category endpoints.

methods.name: list_categories(db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all categories, returning them in a list.

methods.name: create_category(payload: CategoryCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new category based on provided data.

methods.name: update_category(category_id: int, payload: CategoryUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing category identified by category_id.

methods.name: delete_category(category_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a category identified by category_id.
